brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

No drawer part placed - requirement not achievable in current compact arrangement without additional reconfiguration.

requirements.requirement: Spike at corner where three bases meet
requirements.evidence: spike:0#0,0|1,-1|1,0 mount spike at junction [0,0],[1,-1],[1,0] - three bases meeting at corner
platform-sm accessory set on that spike via setSpikeAccessory platform-sm; large platform refused due to SPIKE_CLASH with stacking collar, small platform applied as tryInstead s72

finish.summary: Built compact 4-base desk unit with upper deck and caps, with mount spike at three-base corner holding small platform (platform-sm). Drawer could not be completed - configurator never offered a drawer socket despite half bases; honest unmet.

lines.label: Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
